scripts.test: echo 'Running vitest via turbo...' && turbo run test
scripts.test:update: cd apps/web && bun vitest run --update && cd ../../packages/@tom/utils && bun vitest run --update
scripts.deploy:web: turbo run build --filter=@tom/web && cd apps/web && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:cms: cd apps/cms && opennextjs-cloudflare build --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV
scripts.deploy:sophie: cd apps/sophie && opennextjs-cloudflare build --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV
